name: llm-language
description: Self-evolving prompt meta-compiler for the Fable 5 / Opus 4.8 era (Mythos-class aware) with xhigh/max effort, adaptive thinking, task budgets, dual-layer memory (ROSETTA.md + auto-memory), AND skill-level meta-refinement. v4.4: FABLE-5-ERA RETARGET — complexity map gains a model dimension (Opus 4.8 workhorse default, Fable 5 escalation tier above 'max on Opus' for frontier long-horizon work, mandatory cost guards + stop rules), Agent-tool dispatch fixed to alias enum (sonnet|opus|haiku|fable; version-pinned values invalid), refusal/fallbacks API surface in rewriting rules, 3-axis escalation (depth=effort, capability=Opus 4.8→Fable 5, breadth=workflow/ultracode — Phase 1.3b), terminology guard (Mythos-class, never 'Claude 5 family'), refreshed P0 deprecation table (Opus 4 → claude-opus-4-8 on 2026-06-15; Agent SDK credit claim; Fable credits cutover 06-22/23; Opus 4.1 → 08-05), update skill v3.2, new reference fable-5-era.md, MASPO ICML 2026 + self-evolving-memory papers. v4.3: NATIVE /goal INTEGRATION — Phase 1.4b Goal Gate (8-clause activation predicate: complex/critical + xhigh/max effort + task_budget≥200K + multi-step + hooks_enabled + no_loop + no_outer_goal + depth=0) and Phase 5 Execute Wrapper (deterministic condition synthesis from acceptance-criteria + sub-tasks allowlist, NOT Producer-authored). Three-evaluator architecture (Producer self-check + Critic 10-dim + /goal Haiku trajectory) confirmed non-redundant. Bound N=15 (complex) / N=30 (critical) / N_max=40. Three cost guards (per-run, per-day, per-month). EVIDENCE block mandatory per turn. Allowlist scope-creep prevention. Critical tier behind feature_flag.goal_critical until false-positive rate < 5% over ≥50 runs. v4.2: update skill v3.0 with /goal tracking, P0 deprecation watch. v4.1 still ships: automatic ROSETTA updates via 5 shipped hooks (SessionStart/UserPromptSubmit/Stop/TaskCompleted/PreCompact), Phase 7 Skill Audit auto-fixes, /llm-language:refine-skills, Jarvis v3.0 overhaul, micro-task methodology. 10 scoring dimensions, threshold 9.3. Backward-compatible with Opus 4.6/Sonnet 4.6.
